_comment: Mutation testing for the web DECISION logic (docs/QUALITY.md §4, docs/testing/TEST_STRATEGY.md): permissions, plan/money math, filtering, scoping, export escaping, report aggregation, route gating. saas-data.ts and reports-data.ts are in scope because they hold real derivation logic. tenant-data.ts is deliberately OUT: ~400 of its 650 lines are seeded-data GENERATORS, whose mutants are both low-signal and enormously expensive (a full run exceeded 50 minutes and did not finish) — it stays in the coverage denominator instead, where it measures cheaply. Fixture blobs (mock-data, monitor-data, host-data) and type-only modules are excluded outright. UI/pages are guarded behaviorally by the component and e2e suites. 'break' is the ratcheting floor — raise it as the score improves, never lower.
